import pathlib,os,hashlib,subprocess,json,time
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
source=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave140/out/fs-w140-full-fp8-pack32-micro-device-profile-r1')
stage=root/('out/'+'fs-w140-full-fp8-pack32-caller-remote-ingest-r1'+'-input')
output=root/('out/'+'fs-w140-full-fp8-pack32-caller-remote-ingest-r1'+'-parquet')
post=json.loads((root/'research/run-logs/fs-w140-full-fp8-pack32-micro-device-profile-r1.postflight.json').read_text())
assert post['host_clean'] and post['command_returncode']==0
assert source.is_dir() and not stage.exists() and not output.exists()
def digest(p):
 with p.open('rb') as f: return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
files=sorted(p for p in source.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
assert files and all(not p.is_symlink() for p in files)
before={str(p.relative_to(source)):digest(p) for p in files}
stage.mkdir(parents=True)
for p in files:
 target=stage/p.relative_to(source);target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);os.link(p,target)
neffs=list(stage.rglob('*.neff'))
for trace in list(stage.rglob('*.ntff')):
 for neff in neffs:
  target=trace.parent/neff.name
  if not target.exists(): os.link(neff,target)
  elif target.stat().st_ino!=neff.stat().st_ino: assert digest(target)==digest(neff)
command=['/opt/aws/neuron/bin/neuron-explorer','view','--session-dir',str(stage),'--ingest-only','--output-format','parquet','--output-file',str(output)]
print('INGEST_START '+json.dumps({'source':str(source),'stage':str(stage),'output':str(output),'command':command,'raw_preserved':False,'local_raw_transfer_in_progress':True,'source_sha256':before}),flush=True)
start=time.monotonic();completed=subprocess.run(command,cwd=stage)
after={str(p.relative_to(source)):digest(p) for p in files}
assert before==after
print('INGEST_COMPLETE '+json.dumps({'returncode':completed.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'tables':len(list(output.rglob('*.parquet'))),'raw_hashes_unchanged':True,'instruction_files':[(str(p),p.stat().st_size) for p in output.rglob('Instruction.parquet')]}),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)
